{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df_completed_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute the mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed_clean['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders after filtering and removing QA orders
print(len(df_completed_clean))

# Print the mean revenue
print(mean_revenue)

# Print the number of QA orders removed
print((df_completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
